description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractServiceBase' in Java for building secure and non-secure network services. It handles configuration, port management, SSL/TLS setup, health checks, and lifecycle methods for starting and stopping services. Subclasses are expected to implement specific server behaviors such as port numbers and actual server management.

classes.name: AbstractServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for network services including configuration handling, port selection, SSL/TLS setup, health checks, and lifecycle management. Designed for extension by concrete service implementations.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer; defaults to a NoopTracer if none is provided. Logs the tracer implementation used.

methods.name: setHealthCheckServer
methods.description: Sets the health check server instance used for health monitoring, requiring non-null input.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the component, registering health check resources and invoking subclass-specific startup logic.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement startup procedures. Returns succeeded future by default.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the component, invoking subclass-specific shutdown logic.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to implement shutdown procedures. Returns succeeded future by default.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Configures readiness health checks; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Configures liveness health checks; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Abstract method to return the default secure port number.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Abstract method to return the default insecure port number.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Abstract method to get the port the server is actually listening on for secure traffic.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Abstract method to get the port for insecure traffic.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Determines the active secure port, prioritizing actual listening port, then configuration, with fallback to unconfigured constant.

methods.name: getInsecurePort
methods.description: Determines the active insecure port with similar priority as getPort.

methods.name: checkPortConfiguration
methods.description: Validates port and SSL configuration, ensuring at least one service port is properly configured and ports are distinct.

methods.name: determineSecurePort
methods.description: Returns the configured secure port, logging whether it's default, ephemeral, or standard port.

methods.name: determineInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the configured insecure port, with similar logging as determineSecurePort.

methods.name: isSecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the secure port is enabled based on key and certificate options.

methods.name: isInsecurePortEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the insecure port is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: getBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the bind address for the secure port.

methods.name: getInsecurePortBindAddress
methods.description: Returns the bind address for the insecure port.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Adds trust anchor configuration to NetServerOptions if SSL is enabled and trust options are unset.

methods.name: getServerTrustOptions
methods.description: Returns trust options for server-side SSL; defaults to config's trust options.

methods.name: addTlsKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Configures server options with key and certificate options, enables SSL, and chooses between OpenSSL or JDK SSL engine, also ensuring protocols are appropriately configured.
